elena: Heads-up — saw steady KV cache growth on gpunode-12 during longctx jobs. P50/95 token latencies look fine but resident set is stair-stepping up over ~6h, eviction rate stays low. Suspect fragmentation + long-lived prefix keys from streaming sessions. :eyes:

mike: Can you paste the pprof heap/memory maps and which allocator we're on? jemalloc vs tcmalloc matters for compaction. Also which tenant id if reproducible?

elena: Quick dump at `http://elk/pprof/gpunode-12/heap` — allocator = jemalloc. Tenant `acme-qa` shows disproportionately high residency. pprof top (`pprof top --inuse_space`) shows most bytes in `kv_page` objects and a lot of small allocations around slab class 64.

samir: That's the longctx chat tenant, yep. Two hypotheses: (1) slab-class skew -> internal fragmentation, (2) eviction policy is LRU-ish and longctx hits keep pages live so they never become eviction candidates. Running slab compaction in staging now to see reclaim.

ops-bot: deploy 1719000045 started by samir: slab-compactor-v0.1 -> staging

samir: Quick compaction command I used in staging: 
```
for s in $(ls /var/lib/kv/slabs); do echo compact $s; ./compact --move --force; done
```
Reclaimed ~18% resident over 20m on staging node. Planning a short A/B on gpunode-12 at ~1719000180.

jia: We should also consider soft per-tenant watermarks rather than hard caps — allow short overshoot but increase eviction priority when watermark crossed. And add small random jitter to eviction selection to avoid synchronized thrash between tenants. :thinking: 

elena: Proposed quick eviction-score tweak: 
```
score = base_score + (age_ms / 1e6) + (resident_bytes > watermark ? 1e6 : 0) + rand(0,100)
```
Bump score for pages belonging to tenants over watermark. Will ship to staging if compaction shows stable reclaim.

mike: One more callout — kernel selection / batching heuristics interact here. When batch_size > 8 we see higher sequence lengths which increases prefix reuse churn and KV pressure. Might need to throttle batch sizes for tenants with high residency until compaction/eviction stabilizes.

samir: Confirmed — ran replay with batch=12 and KV growth rate ~2x vs batch=4. For now we can add a per-tenant dynamic batch cap tied to residency.

elena: Plan: (a) run compaction on gpunode-12 tonight (b) ship eviction-score patch to staging tomorrow (c) add telemetry: per-tenant residency histogram + eviction-retry counts (d) run 12h longctx replay and collect heap pprof + slab maps. Volunteers?

jia: :hand: I can onboard the telemetry metrics and dashboards (per-tenant residency, slabs-per-class, eviction-priority distribution).

samir: I'll run compaction + the A/B and collect before/after pprofs. Mike will help with batch throttling experiments.

elena: Thanks. If anyone hits a noisy neighbor in the wild please ping me and include `pprof` link + tenant id. Filing follow-up INF ticket INF-4237 to track this work.
